ambiguity.detail: Clarissa's precise relation to Juliana is implied through insults but not explicitly defined.

verdict.hook_line: You have finally found a man as worthless as everyone thinks you are.
verdict.viewer_takeaway: A scorned noblewoman refuses pity from a rugged stranger who offers her a genuine vow instead.
verdict.why_it_works: Intimate dialogue and intense emotional vulnerability build strong romantic tension right before a powerful cliffhanger line.
